d: Job Summary: Manages a variety of retail services and staff functions.

Duties and Responsibilities: Manages operations which may include all or a substantial combination of outlying stores personalized services vending food automotive warehouses facilities maintenance and administrative functions. Controls financial performance. Identifies and exploits areas of business opportunities.

Provides guidance and assistance to the General Manager on administrative and operational matters. Recommends and implements approved NEXCOM changes in policies and procedures to improve operations. Collaborates with managerial personnel on procedural changes affecting the overall NEX operations.
Responsible for inventory control customer service programs and operational reporting. Functions as Contracting Officer Technical Representative COTR for various vendor contractors.

Directly or through subordinate supervisors responsible for the full range of personnel disciplines. - Analyzes financial statements and other pertinent data to evaluate operational efficiency. Develops and controls an operating budget to include direct and indirect costs sales and profits. Conducts budget reviews and makes adjustments.

Responsible for facility maintenance equipment facility improvement projects and fixed assets etc. Ensures compliance with safety security and fire prevention policies for all facilities. - Carries out EEO policies and communicates support to subordinates.
Performs other related duties as assigned. The incumbent of this position must file a Financial Disclosure Report OGE Form 450 as required

GENERAL EXPERIENCE 3 years experience in responsible work which enabled the applicant to gain a general knowledge of merchandising retail practices and processes skill in dealing with others in person-to- person work relationships and the ability to exercise mature judgment.

Or SUBSTITUTION OF EDUCATION FOR EXPERIENCE 1 year of academic study in a food or management related program above the high school level may be substituted for 9 months of experience up to a maximum of a 4 year bachelors degree for 3 years of general experience.

And SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE 4 years of progressively responsible experience which provided a knowledge of retail and or service type operations practices procedures and merchandising such as sales promotion display of merchandise and or services developing and improving operational plans and controls maintenance of inventory levels and stock controls customer services supervisory experience and maintaining effective sanitation security and safety regulations or similar work which demonstrated the knowledge and abilities to manage retail and or services area.

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Sales Assistant plays a crucial role in the direct interactions with customers aimed at generating sales and ensuring an exemplary shopping experience. This role involves implementing store standards to maintain a clean and inviting shopping environment, greeting and assisting customers with product information, and managing efficient operations at checkout. Additionally, the Sales Assistant contributes to store maintenance and presentation under the guidance of the store management team. Success in this position involves a combination of interpersonal skills and a proactive attitude towards customer service and store operations.
q: Ability to multi-task and maintain store standards
Capability to uphold visual presentation and cleanliness standards
What Qualifies You For The Role
Capability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
r: Create a positive first impression for the customer through an energetic attitude and adhering to dress code.
Greet customers immediately upon entering the store with a smile and sincere non-business-like greeting.
Provide customers with current relevant information about the product.
Offer quality service in the fitting rooms, following up with customers in a timely manner.
Sincerely thank all customers for shopping as they exit the store and invite them back.
Provide efficient service at the cash wrap, offer gift cards, and maintain cash wrap cleanliness.
Capture customer information in the database.
Attempt to add on to sales during checkout interactions.
Create a sparkling clean and organized environment by maintaining store standards and cleanliness.
Carry out housekeeping duties and uphold visual presentation standards as directed by store management.

d: Provide legal advice on land development, master planning, subdivision, titling, and related regulatory approvals.
Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize real estate agreements, including sale, lease, development, off-plan sales, and leasing documentation.
Liaise with REGA and other relevant regulatory authorities, including matters involving the Ejar platform and Wafi program.

Draft and negotiate documentation for hotel and branded residence developments, including letters of intent, term sheets, technical services agreements, brand licensing agreements, and hotel management arrangements.
Provide legal support for facilities management, property management, estate management, and asset management arrangements.
Advise on master community and estate governance frameworks, including community charters, owners’ associations, and estate management structures.

Coordinate with relevant legal and business subject-matter experts on matters involving tax, insurance, finance, intellectual property, data protection, cybersecurity, local content, environmental, and sustainability considerations.
Identify and manage legal and regulatory risks associated with real estate, hospitality, and land development activities.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent) from a recognized university. A postgraduate legal qualification is advantageous.
Professional Qualification: Qualified lawyer/attorney with admission to practice in a recognized jurisdiction preferred.
8+ years of relevant legal experience, depending on the seniority/grade of the position.
Strong experience in real estate, land development, property transactions, and commercial contracting.
Experience drafting and negotiating sale, lease, development, property management, and related real estate agreements.
Knowledge of the Saudi Arabian real estate regulatory environment, with exposure to REGA, Ejar, and Wafi highly desirable.
Experience supporting hospitality, hotel management, or branded residence developments is advantageous.
Strong contract drafting, negotiation, stakeholder management, and legal advisory skills.
